assets.caption: The scene is a cozy and inviting kitchen, depicted in a realistic style with a warm, rustic tone that evokes a sense of home and comfort. The entire space exudes a well-curated aesthetic, blending modern appliances with traditional wooden elements. To the left, a large window allows natural light to flood the kitchen, highlighting the smooth, light-colored wooden floor that extends throughout the room, creating an airy feel. Opposite the main cooking area, a small breakfast nook with a compact table and chairs offers a casual dining spot, perhaps adorned with a simple vase of fresh flowers. Further into the room, past the visible refrigerator, a pantry area with custom shelving holds an array of preserved goods and kitchen essentials, organized neatly. A back door leads to a small patio or garden, offering a glimpse of greenery and fresh air, extending the natural feel of the interior. The walls are painted in a soft, neutral shade, complementing the wood tones and creating a cohesive and tranquil environment. Overhead, additional recessed lighting in the ceiling provides ample illumination for evening cooking and dining. The wooden floor continues into adjacent rooms, suggesting an open-plan layout or consistent flooring throughout the living space. The 360 scene is faultless.
